CITY OF LA VERNE
  SENIOR ADVISORY COMMITTEE
  AGENDA

Terry Kistler, Chair  La Verne Community Center
Bette Donovan, Member  Classroom 1
Edward Padgett, Member  3680 D Street
Scott Snider, Member  La Verne, CA 91750
Jenny Jolly, Member  (909) 596-8776
George Borst, Member
Yvonne Duran, Staff Liaison
Armando Cisneros, Staff Liaison
Robyn Olsen, Staff Liaison

  Wednesday, May 21, 2025 – 10:00 a.m.
  La Verne Community Center Classroom 1

Attendance and participation at the City of La Verne Senior Advisory Committee meetings are
welcomed and appreciated. Community engagement provides the Committee with valuable
information. In compliance with the American Disabilities Act, any person with a disability who
requires a modification or accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact the
La Verne Community Center at (909) 596-8776 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.

Public comments will be allowed near the conclusion of the meeting.

  1. ROLL CALL – Terry Kistler, Bette Donovan, Edward Padgett, Scott Snider, Jenny Jolly,
  George Borst

  2. PRESENTATIONS –Eric Scherer, Director of Community Development, City of La Verne

  3. APPROVAL OF MINUTES – April 16, 2025

  4. DISCUSSION & ACTION ITEMS
  a. Senior Nutrition Program – Armando Cisneros
  b. Meals on Wheels Program– Armando Cisneros
  c. Bingo Report – George Borst
  d. Account Balance Update – Armando Cisneros
  e. Monthly Senior Program Fees – Armando Cisneros
  f. Mt. SAC Classes Update- Armando Cisneros
  g. Aging Next – Armando Cisneros
  h. Facilities Report – Yvonne Duran
  i. Upcoming Events – Robyn Olsen
   5. PUBLIC COMMENT
  Public comments will be allowed on items not on the Agenda but within the subject
  matter jurisdiction of the Committee; however, no action may be taken on off-agenda
  items except as provided by law.

  6. STAFF/COMMITTEE COMMUNICATION/INFORMATION

  7. ADJOURNMENT

  The next regularly scheduled meeting of the Senior Advisory Committee will be held at
  10:00 a.m. on June 18 at the La Verne Community Center, 3680 D Street, La Verne CA
  91750.

Posting Statement: On May 15, 2025 a true and correct copy of this Notice was posted on the
bulletin board at La Verne City Hall, 3660 D Street, La Verne, and on the City’s website at
www.cityoflaverne.org
minutes_text:
MINUTES OF THE SENIOR ADVISORY COMMITTEE
  REGULAR MEETING
  Wednesday, May 21, 2025

  ACTION MINUTES
  “See items in italics”
  _________________________________________________________________

1. A regular meeting of the La Verne Senior Advisory Committee was called to order at:
  10:00 AM on Wednesday, May 21, 2025.

  Members present: Edward Padgett, Bette Donovan, Terry Kistler, George Borst,
  Jenny Jolly, Scott Snider.

  Members Absent: None.

  Staff Present: Yvonne Duran, Director of Community Services, Armando
  Cisneros, Community Services Specialist, Robyn Olsen, Community
  Services Specialist.

  It was moved by Scott Snider and seconded by Ed Padgett to approve the
  minutes of the Wednesday, April 16, 2025 meeting. Motion carried.

2. Guest Speaker: Eric Scherer, Director of Community Development, City of La
  Verne. He presented updates on the General Plan and Zoning Ordinance. The City
  adopted the new “General Plan” for the overall outlook at the next 20 years in La
  Verne. The last plan was made in 1998. Eric also provided updates on Old Town
  La Verne Businesses Improvements, Old Town sidewalk dining and furniture
  policy, and the Metro A Line as well as other development projects potentially
  happening in La Verne. He also explained that there may be many new
  businesses going into vacant spaces within the City.

  Unfinished Business

3. Senior Nutrition Program:

  Congregate Meals: 575 meals were served to an average of 24 participants in
  April.

  Meals on Wheels: N/A.

4. Bingo Report: Bingo receipts totaled $8,405.00. Ending balance in the
  account through March was $1,205.00 after $7,200 in payouts and expenses.
  Liabilities to Bingo West were $674.00. Liabilities to the City of La Verne,
  $534.00. The number of players in attendance for the month of March: 273.

5. Account Balance: $5,594.66
 6. Senior Program Fees: All programs are paid.

7. MT. SAC Classes: Spring session began on Monday, February 24 and will be
  coming to an end on Friday, June 20.

8. Aging Next: N/A.

  New Business

9. Facilities Report: Roof of City Hall almost complete. All the bushes near the
  south side of City Hall have been removed. Drought-tolerant plants will take
  their place. More spaces will now be open for parking once the roof project is
  complete.

10. Upcoming Events

  •  Thursday, May 22nd – PVTA Public Hearing, 10:00AM-12:00PM.
  •  Tuesday, May 27th – Mt. SAC Registration, 10:30AM-12:30PM.
  •  Thursday, May 29th – Excursion: Old Town Haunts in Old Town San Diego, 7:30AM-6:30PM.
  •  Friday, June 6th – Senior Seminar: Emotional Intelligence, YWCA, 10:30AM.
  •  Monday, June 9th – Movie Matinee, Hidden Figures, 12:30PM.
  •  Thursday, June 12th – Excursion: Yaamava Resort and Casino, 9:00AM-4:00PM.

  Public Comments: Yvonne Duran Presented the results of the
  Commission/Committees and stated the Senior Advisory Committee remained
  unchanged. Scott Snider stated that Hillcrest is in the process of roof maintenance
  and landscaping.

  Adjourn: The meeting was adjourned at 11:00AM. The next meeting will be held on
  Wednesday, June 18, 2025 at 10:00AM.

  Submitted by:
  Armando Cisneros
  Community Services Specialist
